blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Residents of southern communities here could gain access to additional primary healthcare services as early as November. Cebu City Mayor Nestor Archival is targeting the opening of the long-idle P9.9-million Labangon health center under a proposed operating arrangement with Vicente Sotto Memorial Medical Center (VSMMC). Archival said the city planned to formalize ownership of the facility and secure an agreement for VSMMC to manage its operations, equipment, and personnel. However, the proposal still needs to go through the City Council and comply with regulatory requirements. “We really want to finish this within November,” Archival said in an […]...
